region.name_my: ဧရာဝတီတိုင်းဒေသကြီး

scope: Structured version of the preceding crop-fit shortlist; not independently reverified for this export.
limitations: Preliminary crop shortlist, not a measured ranking of profitability or land suitability.
District-level guidance does not establish suitability for an individual field.
Check township, field elevation, drainage, salinity, freshwater availability and crop timing before selecting crops.
Alternative crops listed are conditional candidates, not district-wide recommendations.

districts.name_my: ပုသိမ်ခရိုင်
districts.conditions_and_caveats: Conditional post-rice options; check drainage and freshwater availability. Pulse suitability is based on regional practice, not a district-wide study.
Conditional post-rice options where fields drain in time and retain sufficient moisture.

districts.name_my: ဟင်္သာတခရိုင်
districts.primary_crop_fit: Monsoon rice followed by black gram
districts.conditions_and_caveats: Rice–pulse cropping is documented in Hinthada Township; do not generalize township findings to the entire district. Low, poorly drained fields have fewer options.

districts.name_my: မြန်အောင်ခရိုင်
districts.conditions_and_caveats: Pulse suitability requires township-level checking; do not assume the district matches Hinthada.

districts.name_my: မအူပင်ခရိုင်
districts.conditions_and_caveats: Conditional post-rice options depending on drainage, harvest timing and residual moisture.

districts.name_my: မြောင်းမြခရိုင်
districts.primary_crop_fit: Rice, including suitable local Pawsan varieties
districts.conditions_and_caveats: Summer rice requires dependable freshwater. Pawsan suitability depends on local growing conditions.

districts.name_my: ဖျာပုံခရိုင်
districts.primary_crop_fit: Monsoon rice; suitable Pawsan varieties in established growing areas
districts.conditions_and_caveats: Summer rice only where freshwater is available; saltwater intrusion restricts dry-season cultivation.

districts.name_my: လပွတ္တာခရိုင်
districts.conditions_and_caveats: Summer rice only where freshwater conditions permit; saltwater exposure limits dry-season options.
